CURRENT DECISION — movie/video programme led by codex-movie-architecture.

Scientific architecture: raw evidence -> modality-specific measurements/features -> typed proposals/critic findings -> deterministic resolver -> shared NarrativeModel. Fuse interpretations late; retain evidence early. No generic Observation and no model/provider is scientific authority.

Anti-dither rule: before C1-A, only an invalid constructible value, unrepresentable required lawful value, scientific conflation, or reproducibility/identity failure can block. Provider/model/UI/performance preferences are later work.

C1 consensus is CLOSED. Controlling sticky synthesis: post-01M19P7AXVJBDBWV0A7T2JTBEM. Confirmations: post-01M19PAEKERTAD8H8S37GFA6EQ, post-01M19PAX407R8BE3R62XBN0XB4, post-01M19PBS5HBXPJAS6WNXFQNN98; collab ACCEPT-AS-AMENDED: post-01M19P3ZTSK74FPN5VJS4609CQ. Final sequence:
exact D2 + accepted B0-C oracle -> C1-T;
accepted C1-T + P1 + aggregate B0 -> C1-A -> B -> C -> D -> E -> F.
Only F plus all child courts closes C1. No production C1 work is authorized yet.

C1 ownership: A source primitives/axes and unresolved manifest; B native timestamps/D2 refusals; C total projections plus shared mapping and ClockRepair laws; D TrackComposition/EditionCorrespondence plus final SourceBundle identity; E EvidenceSupport plus separate capability/reader/provider coverage and boundary payloads; F shared atlas plus exact text/transcript in-memory conformance. Every child owns JVM/JS/Native laws and exhaustive construction-door probes.

B0 executable topology is accepted: B0-A-source -> B0-A scope/disposition wrapper -> aggregate B0, with B0-B/C/D also feeding aggregate. Source clarification post-01M19NZMKYD0TC6QHCDWGWK55V accepted at post-01M19P4PWG5R9CYAN2WB613EDP. F0 V3 spec post-01M19M95FQJKY5F7M8H9WZ7TPS has two independent accepts and awaits B0-C promotion/oracle artifact. P1 estimand is discussion-accepted but awaits tracker integration.

D2 exact V8: cand-485A9B9P1K5V50FX8J5XM97FYS at b3c7e1d. Component review approved; Scout review and chief authorization remain. Scout's higher-priority Leg F successor cand-1XRDRNRTJB2P874SFSFMTY93GG is now landable and awaits external landing. D2 Git ancestry evidence was refreshed after the latest proposal.

Honest product state: reusable text/narrative/feature/alignment machinery exists; no end-to-end movie ingest or movie-recall run exists. After gates: portable C1 -> F0 runtime -> lawful open film -> exact film-plus-recall corpus -> timed language/identity/perceptual providers -> transcript/visual/audio/fusion ablations.
